text:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC-4823 - High 5xx spike detected in eu-west CANARY during blue/green rollout. Error rate ~8.7% on /v1/generate. Paging alex (oncall).

alex: Ack, looking. I'm on it.

maria: I'm seeing repeated 502s from model-proxy (<eu-west-canary-*>). Upstream runtime returning 503. Quick logs:
```
[2026-11-04T09:32:41Z] model-proxy eu-west-canary-1 502 upstream returned 503
[2026-11-04T09:32:42Z] runtime eu-west-canary-2 kv-cache-miss, model failed to load
```

deploy-bot: Canary started 09:15Z. Traffic weights: blue=80%, green=20%. Deployed commit: d4e5c3a. Canary config: boot-strapped model-v2-quant.

jamie: Possible bad model variant in green canary - model-v2-quant has different tokenization pack. Could cause runtime OOM/failures.

alex: Trying an immediate quick mitigation: scale down green pods to 0 to stop traffic -> run: `kubectl scale deployment canary-green -n inference --replicas=0`

ops-bot: Scaling executed: canary-green replicas: 3 -> 0 (kubectl apply ok)

maria: After scale-down, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.2% for eu-west. Looks like green was triggering proxy errors. But DNS shows some requests still hitting eu-west-green LB IPs.

sre-lead: On-call handoff incoming in 20m. Need to capture RCA checklist and impact window. Alex, open an incident ticket with mitigation steps + customers affected.

alex: Created internal incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4823 (private). Noting mitigation: scaled green to 0, paused canary rollout, rolled back feature flag for 'model-route-v2'.

jamie: We didn't fully roll back the deployment — only scaled green. Recommend flipping feature flag kill-switch to route all traffic to the stable 'blue' variant.

alex: Flipping feature flag now -> `POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle/model-route-v2 body={'state':'off','reason':'canary-failure'}`

deploy-bot: Flag toggle accepted. Routing updated: eu-west traffic -> blue only.

product-cs: Notifying customer success: affected customers in EU region with traffic during 09:15-09:33Z. Early estimates: ~120 API keys had error rates >5%.

product-cs: Drafted customer message for affected tenants. Can someone review? "We experienced degraded responses for a subset of EU customers during a canary rollout. We've routed traffic back to the stable variant and are investigating root cause."

maria: Root cause signal: green canary pods showed model load failures and increasing latency leading to proxy 502s. Also found a config mismatch in DNS SRV record that caused some egress to an old green LB for a short window.

alex: Can you paste the DNS diff?

maria: diff between expected SRV and live:
```
_expected: srv-eu-west-01.redwood-inference.internal -> 10.12.5.2
_live: srv-eu-west-01.redwood-inference.internal -> 10.12.5.7 (stale IP for canary-green LB)
```

sre-lead: That's the cross-region/route mismatch — control plane propagated new LB IPs but the edge DNS cached an old record in one AZ. So a fraction of traffic was still sent to canary-green after scale-down.

ops-bot: Purged edge DNS cache for eu-west AZ-1. Confirmed negative TTL respect corrected. Edge now reflecting updated SRV.

jamie: Action items: (1) rollback model-v2-quant from canary images until we validate tokenization; (2) add canary health check to detect model load failure within 10s and fail fast; (3) hard TTL zero on SRV during rollouts for 15m window.

alex: Adding to incident document. Will run a formal rollback of canary image tomorrow during a maintenance window. For now we've remediated live traffic.

sre-lead: Handoff: @maria you'll take lead on postmortem; @jamie you'll own rollout gating tests; I'll follow for infra cleanup. Next on-call is @sam at 10:00Z; sam, please pick up monitoring alerts and customer comms.

ops-bot: Handoff recorded. On-call shift change scheduled 10:00Z. Pagerduty: incident will remain active until postmortem published.

sam: Ack. I'll join the post-call and monitor for any regressions. Saved logs and exported artifacts to https://artifacts.internal/incidents/INC-4823/

product-cs: Customer-notify template approved. Sending now.

alex: Closing active mitigations: traffic routed to stable, green scaled to 0, DNS flushed. We'll keep incident open for RCA and follow-up.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4823 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to Sev3. Last update 09:54Z.

sre-lead: Good containment. Postmortem due EOD. Include timeline, root cause (model variant + DNS stale SRV), impact slice (customer list), and preventative controls (healthcheck, TTL policy, rollback automation).

maria: I'll start collecting more logs and link them in the doc. Adding observed graphs for 5xx spike and pod restarts.

alex: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
